videos.script: Lessons one to five put every trace in a file and read it with scripts. A team needs a screen, and a screen that knows what a model call is. {{why}} Langfuse is open source, and it runs on your own machine: six containers, a queue between the part that receives and the part that files. {{langfuse}} The assistant's spans go to it with two environment variables and no new code. {{send}} It reads the names it knows. The model call becomes a generation. The user is missing, the root looks like a model call, and every cost is zero. {{names}} A small processor adds the names it reads, at the edge, and the assistant stays as it was. {{adapter}} Prices are counted when a trace arrives, not when it is read. And thumbs become scores, joined by trace id. {{scores}} LangSmith is a hosted service, so its SDK talks to a small recorder of your own instead. The recorder shows what would have left: the customer's address, her name, and the machine's details. Redaction takes the address. It cannot see the name. {{langsmith}} Choose where the data may go first, who will run it second, and features last. {{choose}}
